post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by changing SBC source rank, SBC/revenue thresholds, revenue/gross-profit floors, fact-age windows, allocator top-N, notional, hold days, or cooldown on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Retry only with closed forward allocator displacement rows, per-share SBC burden net buybacks, or grant-value normalization evidence that changes the underlying data edge.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The SBC burden source did not add enough incremental allocator replacement value after lagged consensus. It either overlapped existing accepted source dates or displaced better lower-rank allocator rows, especially versus the strong exp-20260611-005 comparator.
